newsitem.title: USA: Colorado tax surplus jumps to $131 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Colorado tax surplus jumps to $131 mln - paper.

text.p: Colorado's tax bonanza has grown to an estimated $131 million, the Denver Post reported Thursday.
In early June, state economists forecast a surplus this year of between $40 million and $60 million.
But this week, the forecast was raised to $131 million, according to the Post.
Gov. Roy Romer, a Democrat, has argued that the revenues should be reinvested in state infrastructure. Many Republican lawmakers want to return the money to taxpayers, the newspaper said.
